amendments: Corrected two factual claims about the published study after reading its internet appendix: the clustering it uses for underpricing, and its control set.
Added the paper's stub rule, evaluated on the article revision as of the cutoff date rather than today's article.

Added a day-1 exactness restriction: the dependent variable is offer-to-first-close, so rows whose earliest available bar is not the listing day are excluded. Dates only, blind to outcome and treatment.

spec.treatment: notable_pre_ipo (1 if a Wikipedia article existed before listing minus CUTOFF_DAYS, else 0)
spec.standard_errors: clustered by offering year-quarter (one-way). The published study clusters two-way by Fama-French 48 industry and year for underpricing; industry is unavailable here, so this does NOT match and the standard errors are not directly comparable
spec.winsorization: underpricing winsorised at the 1st and 99th percentiles; the raw-sample result is reported alongside, and neither is chosen after the fact
spec.sample_restriction: rows where the first available price bar falls on the listing date (day1_gap_days == 0)
not_reproducible_from_this_data: offer price revision (no filed ranges join to priced rows)
SIC industry (delisted 2006-16 tickers absent from company_tickers.json)
firm age, VC backing (need paid sources)

the paper's full control set: VC backing, underwriter tier (top_tier), share overhang, positive EPS, log sales, firm age, tech dummy and prior-15-day Nasdaq return -- these carry its largest coefficients (top_tier +5.83, VC +6.47) and most of its R2 of 0.140
